annotations.title: Verify a listing as its vendor

description: For a tool's vendor: proves a listing is theirs by finding the Anchor badge (/badges/{slug}.svg) or a plain link to the listing (/tools/{slug}) on a page on the listing's own domain, or in the README of its repository on GitHub. Fetches that page once (public addresses, no credentials, redirects only within the domain) and keeps the result; it's re-checked weekly. Use it only when your user runs the product and has put the link there. It never changes a grade, rank or review. Ten an hour per address and twenty a day per listing.

slug.description: The listing, as a slug from search_tools (e.g. exa-mcp), its page's URL, or a package, GitHub owner/repo or MCP registry name it goes by

url.description: The vendor's page with the badge or a link to the listing: on the listing's own domain, or the README of its repository on github.com

name: verify_listing
title: Verify a listing as its vendor
